subject: Problem with ShinyApps(): Build exited with non-zero status: 1

messages.author: 22b20bb346174761
messages.subject: Problem with ShinyApps(): Build exited with non-zero status: 1
parts:
Hi
I am trying to use ShinyApps() to upload my shiny application to the server. I've got two big data packages written by myself, uploaded to github and installed again on R from github. The size of one package is 300 MB and the size of another is about 370 MB. I have configured my shinyapps account according to the tutorial on shinyapps.io. However, when I run the ShinyApps() command to start uploading, an error appears as follows:


Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application...
Waiting for task: 27653
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 12283
  building: Building package: Affymoe430Expr (0.99.0)
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 27654 error: Unhandled Exception: Error building Affymoe430Expr (0.99.0). Build exited with non-zero status: 1


The package Affymoe430Expr (0.99.0) is about 370 MB.
I am using mac system(10.9.1) and my R version is 3.0.2. My rstudio is also most up-to-dated. Could anyone solve this problem?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Problem with ShinyApps(): Build exited with non-zero status: 1
parts:
Jason,

I am looking into this issue. It's clear that the size of this package is breaking things, but it's not clear if this is a bug with ShinyApps, or a limitation/issue with GitHub.

Side note: It's usually considered a bad idea to have such large binary files in a Git repository. Unfortunately, only CRAN and GitHub packages are supported at the moment for ShinyApps. 

-Andy
